tools.name: detect_address_poisoning_lookalike
tools.description: Compare a destination address with up to 50 addresses you already trust (address book, past counterparties): catches vanity "dust attack" look-alikes with the same first and last characters. Verdict exact_match / lookalike / partial / no_match. PAID: $0.001 per call or 1 prepaid credits, no account.

tools.name: payment_options
tools.description: FREE. Prices, the receiving address, the x402-over-MCP retry format, and how to use a prepaid credits key instead (bought with a plain USDC transfer, no x402 client needed).

tools.name: credits_quote
tools.description: FREE, no x402 needed. Returns a quote id and the EXACT USDC amount to send on Base from your address to this service. After sending, call credits_claim with the quote id to receive an ssk_ key. 1 credit = $0.001 of list price (OFAC check 5, chat message 3, address check 1, payout list 50).

tools.name: credits_claim
tools.description: FREE. After the transfer from credits_quote has landed on Base, returns your ssk_ credits key (claiming again returns the same key). Then set the MCP header "Authorization: Bearer <key>" or pass _meta["safe-send/credits-key"].

tools.name: credits_balance
tools.description: FREE. Credits left and calls made on the key sent as the MCP header "Authorization: Bearer ssk_..." (or _meta["safe-send/credits-key"]).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_crypto_chat_message_for_scams, credits_quote · Private data: screen_wallet_ofac_sanctions, screen_payout_recipient_list, check_crypto_chat_message_for_scams, check_crypto_address_before_sending · Public sink: check_crypto_chat_message_for_scams, credits_quote, credits_claim, credits_balance · Destructive: screen_payout_recipient_list, payment_options.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_crypto_chat_message_for_scams, credits_quote · Private data: screen_wallet_ofac_sanctions, screen_payout_recipient_list, check_crypto_chat_message_for_scams, check_crypto_address_before_sending · Public sink: check_crypto_chat_message_for_scams, credits_quote, credits_claim, credits_balance · Destructive: screen_payout_recipient_list, payment_options

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
